research_rationale:
Official FR5789 PDF page5 shows three contingent succession designations, the ranking rule and a completed supersession of EO9866. Corrected disjoint inventory removes railroad-table contamination. EO10753 supplies a replacement standing succession arrangement and expressly supersedes10156 on February15,1958. The three contingency designations remain capable of repeated application; absence of a presently sick or absent Secretary does not end them. Paragraph3 completed its own one-time legal disposition on August26,1950 and did not require an extrinsic performance fact. Whole-order latest first end is February15,1958. Ending text is a mirror transcription, provisionally used under the October21 ruling; human_certified=0.
